issues.desc: background.md ## Solution Tradeoffs option (b): "S-sized but only MASKS the defect" — the abbreviation S-sized is not defined anywhere in background.md or CLAUDE.md; a new reader cannot determine whether S refers to small story-size, sprint scope, or another concept. Standalone readability (Dimension 2) is broken for this term.

background.md ## Key Insights claims: "DONE merge critical section (transition-orchestrator.ts, acquired via acquireMainWriteLockRegistered at ~line 290)". Verification shows acquireMainWriteLockRegistered is actually called in done-effects.ts:268, not directly in transition-orchestrator.ts. transition-orchestrator.ts calls applyDoneMergeEffects() which internally acquires the lock. Both the file attribution and the line number are incorrect for the actual lock acquisition point (Dimension 4).
